generator: Deterministic extraction from existing species atlas
boundsProvenance: Pillow direct alpha measurement after 2x nearest-neighbor scale and anchor placement
anchorProvenance: Source cell visible bbox bottom centered at shared (192,288) anchor
transformation: 128x128 source cell extracted and enlarged 2x with NEAREST, then placed on a transparent 384x384 canvas. Source color and alpha values preserved except for explicitly listed detached components.
